label: PREVIEW/automated retest of iteration 26 HIGH fixes
environment: PREVIEW deployment https://app-first-signin.preview.emergentagent.com (build shared-v1-store-submission-2026-09-13). Never production. No real SMS. Reviewer keys and disposable fixtures kept in /tmp/yash-private/*, never printed.
summary: Both HIGH fixes from iteration 26 are verified: (1) production-scope deletion now increments users.session_version and the stale bearer token returns HTTP 401 SESSION_REVOKED (was 403 ACCOUNT_INACTIVE); (2) /ai-assistant, /ai-consent and /review-keys correctly redirect to /login on a hard URL navigation when no session exists (memory-only web sessions), instead of the earlier generic Unavailable card. Backend B4 with the CORRECT /api/pdf-upload/init payload (batch_id + file_size + sha256 + total_chunks + mode='template_v1') now passes end-to-end: the review-scope worker recorded the job in review__import_jobs and the batch in review__batches while unprefixed import_jobs, batches, products, pdf_jobs counts stayed flat. B6 (reviewer deletion + fresh sample profile) passes with tombstone in review__users, review_profile_recreated audit event and profile_recreated:true on re-login. B7 passes end-to-end (consent grant / chat / withdraw / in-flight race / delete / 401 / DEL- reference / outbox event / replay 401). B10 confirms production untouched: only the disposable customer's own deletion produced deltas (deletion_requests +1, deleted_identities +1, integration_outbox +1); users, products, requests, media_assets, ai_chat_history, batches, import_jobs, pdf_jobs, sms_log unchanged; sms_log has 0 rows for 9100009901/9100009902. UI F3 (AI consent card → allow → quick prompt → real AI reply in ~6 s) and F4 (Profile → delete-account → simulated OTP note with STORE-REVIEW ENVIRONMENT heading and prefilled OTP → confirm → /login → re-sign in same key → home banner + Profile shows 'Review Customer (synthetic)' + Reward Points 0) both pass. Deprecated packages detected: none new. Deprecated style props (shadow*, props.pointerEvents) still logged as warnings on multiple screens (unchanged from iteration 26). One residual UI issue: on client-side navigation to /review-keys from an authenticated store-review-admin session the route redirects to /login instead of rendering the review-keys-error card with title 'Not available in the store-review environment' — the auth-hydration gate now over-corrects and either (a) treats the memory-only reviewer session as absent after the pushState+popstate rerender or (b) redirects before the 403 REVIEW_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN error state can be rendered.

ui_bugs.issue: Client-side navigation from /panel to /review-keys (history.pushState + popstate) while signed in as store-review-admin lands on /login instead of the review-keys-error card. The hydration gate in useEffect at lines 57-61 sees a transient user=null on the popstate-driven remount and calls router.replace('/login') before the reviewer session is picked up. Backend still returns 403 REVIEW_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN correctly if reached. Fix option: keep the current authLoading gate, and additionally either (a) suppress the router.replace('/login') for one tick after mount so AuthContext memory-only state can settle, or (b) also treat 'user with role in reviewer set' as authenticated for this screen so the REVIEW_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN path can render.

Deprecated props.pointerEvents used instead of style.pointerEvents across the same screens.

Migrate deprecated 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' and move props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents on login, panel, review-access, review-keys, ai-assistant, delete-account screens (unchanged from iteration 26).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend hard fixes (401 SESSION_REVOKED and hard-nav → /login) are now landed and verified. The only remaining regression is UI F2 client-side navigation on /review-keys while signed in as store-review-admin: the auth-hydration guard in app/review-keys.tsx redirects to /login on the popstate remount before user is repopulated, so the intended REVIEW_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN error card never renders. Backend contract for that path (GET /api/admin/review/status → 403 REVIEW_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN with the correct message) is unchanged and correct. Disposable-customer fixture 'e2e-cust-18ce19' is CONSUMED — ask the main agent to reissue /tmp/yash-private/e2e-fixtures.json before another B7 run. Reviewer-customer was tombstoned and recreated in this run (review_profile_recreated audit event present), which also cleared the reviewer OTP rate window.
rca_of_issue: app/review-keys.tsx (line 57-61) now waits for AuthContext to hydrate before firing /admin/review/status (fixing the iteration-26 race), but the guard still redirects to /login on any render where user is null. Under Playwright's history.pushState + PopStateEvent flow, expo-router unmounts /panel and remounts /review-keys; during that remount tick useAuth() briefly returns { user: null, loading: false } before the memory-held reviewer session is passed down, so router.replace('/login') fires ahead of the render that would have shown the REVIEW_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN error card. Reproduction: sign in with store-review-admin on /review-access → land on /panel → in the same tab: history.pushState({},'','/review-keys'); window.dispatchEvent(new PopStateEvent('popstate')) → observe redirect to /login. Direct backend probe with the same reviewer bearer token still returns 403 REVIEW_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN as expected. Suggested mitigation: gate the redirect on !authLoading && user===null && !justMounted (defer one tick), or render the error card whenever /admin/review/status returns 403 with code REVIEW_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN regardless of the current user snapshot.
hard_rules_observed: Never called send-otp / delete-account/request / phone-change/request / admin/sms/test on a production-scope session; never touched the owner (9999813334) or the owner console positively; never rotated/revoked/reset reviewer accounts; disposable fixtures used only within their 6 h window; only synthetic review-scope rows were cleared (review__otp_limits, review__otp_challenges) to defuse OTP_RATE_LIMIT for the reviewer OTP; unprefixed collections were only READ; no keys/OTPs/tokens were printed in this report.
